blocks.orig: During a safari in Tanzania, you will experience the best of the animal world up close. There are few more breathtaking natural spectacles than the Great Migration. Feel the trembling of the ground from afar as you witness millions of animals roaming the Serengeti at the same time. Tanzania is the only place in the world where you can see so many wild animals in one place.
blocks.html: A safari in Tanzania brings you face to face with the finest the animal kingdom has to offer. Few natural spectacles take your breath away like the Great Migration: you can sense the ground shaking from a distance while millions of animals move across the Serengeti at once. Nowhere else on earth lets you watch so many wild animals gathered in a single place as Tanzania does.

blocks.orig: Picture a cheetah on the hunt, hundreds of thousands of hoofs thundering across the Serengeti plains, elephants bathing in the river and endless blue skies. This is Tanzania: the best safari country in Africa. If you want to embark on an authentic African safari, Tanzania offers it all: a unique mix of wildlife, landscapes and captivating cultures. National parks and game reserves cover almost 35% of the country, including Africa’s most famous park Serengeti. Three out of the seven Natural Wonders of Africa are also found in Tanzania. Amongst them are Mount Kilimanjaro, Ngorongoro Crater and the Great Wildebeest Migration – one of the world’s largest wildlife migrations. With all this on offer, if there is one country where you can experience the ultimate safari, it is Tanzania.
blocks.html: Imagine a cheetah mid-hunt, hundreds of thousands of hooves pounding over the Serengeti plains, elephants splashing in the river and a sky of endless blue. That is Tanzania, the finest safari country in Africa. For a genuine African safari Tanzania has everything: a rare combination of wildlife, scenery and fascinating cultures. Nearly 35% of the country is given over to national parks and game reserves, the Serengeti, Africa’s most celebrated park, among them. Tanzania also holds three of the seven Natural Wonders of Africa, including Mount Kilimanjaro, the Ngorongoro Crater and the Great Wildebeest Migration, one of the biggest wildlife migrations on the planet. With so much to choose from, if any country can give you the ultimate safari it is Tanzania.

blocks.orig: The word ‘Safari’ is the Swahili word meaning ‘long journey’. During a safari, people travel through the bush or jungle to discover beautiful nature and wildlife. Nowadays, a safari is known as a journey through African countries while visiting one or more nature parks. Safari drives in the parks, looking for wildlife, are also called ‘game drives’.
blocks.html: In Swahili, ‘Safari’ simply means ‘long journey’. On a safari, people travel through bush or jungle to discover unspoilt nature and wild animals. Today the term describes a trip through African countries that takes in one or more nature parks. The drives through the parks in search of wildlife are also known as ‘game drives’.
